exclusion_reason: Per-chunk compressed content-addressed streaming is implemented: the packager gzip-encodes each content-addressed chunk, records the stored fraction, and the verify path decodes and hash-checks every chunk against both its stored and content hash. The benchmark stays red because measuring bytes-to-interactive against the declared fraction needs the absent browser streaming runtime.
promotion_trigger: Promote when the streamed package meets the declared bytes-to-interactive fraction with every chunk hash-verified.
expected_failing_assertion: No compressed streaming exists; the package integrity timing covers uncompressed chunk only.
active_gate_evidence: test/package.test.mjs asserts stream-compressed shrinks stored bytes below plain, every chunk hash verifies through the CLI verify path, and a tampered stored chunk is rejected.
procedure: Package the fixture with per-chunk compression declared.
Measure bytes-to-interactive against the declared fraction.
Verify every chunk hash before use.
